bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 macOS 上 ChatGPT 主进程与可信子进程共同监听同一本机调试端口时，换肤错误拒绝连接的问题；仍逐一验证所有监听进程属于同一官方宿主进程树。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed skins rejecting a local debugging port shared by the ChatGPT main process and trusted child processes on macOS; every listener is still verified against the same official host process tree.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复换肤 CDP 验证链在默认 Tokio 工作线程栈上可能溢出并使应用退出的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed a possible app exit caused by the skin CDP verification chain overflowing the default Tokio worker stack.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 兼容皮肤点击“应用”后不再重复询问第三方脚本信任；导入时的来源确认和宿主重启风险确认仍保留。
bugFixes.en-US: Removed the repeated third-party script trust prompt when applying a compatible skin; source confirmation on import and host restart warnings remain.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复开机自启在应用已有实例运行时意外显示主窗口的问题；登录启动保持后台隐藏，手动再次打开仍可恢复窗口。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed launch-at-login unexpectedly showing the main window when the app was already running; login launches stay hidden while manually reopening the app still restores the window.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复带参数或片段的受限深链接被单实例回调错误恢复主窗口的问题；只有固定的无载荷恢复链接可以显示窗口。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed payload-bearing or fragmented restricted deep links incorrectly restoring the main window through the single-instance callback; only the fixed payload-free restore link can show it.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 WorkBuddy 监控在权限被拒绝或澄清问题得到回答后，桌宠展示会一直卡在“询问中”状态的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed WorkBuddy monitoring getting stuck showing “asking” after a permission was denied or a clarifying question was answered.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复设置页将版本号的小写 v 显示成大写 V 的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed Settings displaying the version prefix as uppercase V instead of lowercase v.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 开启开机自动启动后，应用首次自启拉起时主窗口默认保持隐藏，只显示托盘图标和桌宠，不再打扰用户；手动打开应用时窗口显示如常。
featureOptimizations.en-US: When launch-at-login is enabled, the main window now stays hidden on the autostart-triggered launch, showing only the tray icon and pet overlay; manually opening the app still shows the window as before.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: macOS 上隐藏程序坞（Dock）图标，应用完全由系统托盘承载，与关闭主窗口即最小化到托盘的行为保持一致。
featureOptimizations.en-US: The Dock icon is now hidden on macOS, since the app already lives entirely in the system tray and closing the main window already minimizes it there.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠浮窗最小尺寸低于 64 像素时，Windows 缩放后的非客户区缩放命中会吞掉点击并进入原生缩放死循环的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed the desktop pet overlay dropping below 64px, which let Windows DPI-scaled non-client resize hit-tests swallow clicks and enter a native resize hang.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复在 Windows 上从主线程同步打开桌宠设置窗导致 WebView2 IPC 自死锁、窗口无法显示且应用无响应的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed opening the desktop pet settings window synchronously on Windows, which deadlocked WebView2 IPC, left the popup hidden, and froze the app.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复桌宠设置窗仍显示系统标题栏，以及冷启动按系统语言检测后未持久化导致浮窗和设置窗回退英文的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed the pet settings window still showing a native title bar, and cold-start locale detection not being persisted so overlay and settings windows fell back to English.
